app.baseline: Your children's bus times, without thinking about it

avertissement.independance: This site has no connection with the municipality of Beckerich or with the school. It was made by a parent, privately.
avertissement.modification: The official plan may be changed at any time, without notice from the municipality.
avertissement.effort: Best efforts will be made to keep this site up to date, with no guarantee.
avertissement.priorite: In case of doubt, the municipality's official document prevails.

onboarding.intro: Enter your address and your children. The app works out, for each of them, the nearest stop and the times. Everything stays on your device.

assistant.adresse: Where do they leave from in the morning?
assistant.periscolaire: What times are they at the Dillendapp?
assistant.adresses: Do they always leave from your home?

adresse.label: Home address
adresse.aide: Type the start of your street, then the number. For example "haapt 76".
adresse.aucunResultat: No address found in the municipality of Beckerich.
adresse.aucunResultatAide: Check the spelling. This site only covers addresses within the municipality.
adresse.confidentialite: Your address is searched on your device. It is never sent anywhere.
adresse.arretAide: Address outside the municipality: name the stop where the child gets on or off. Walking time cannot then be estimated.
adresse.partageeFratrie: This is the household address: changing it here would change it for your other children too.

auDillendapp.matin: Dropped off at the Dillendapp that morning: they do not leave from any other address.
auDillendapp.midi: Has lunch at the Dillendapp that day.
auDillendapp.soir: To be collected at the Dillendapp that evening: the bus takes them nowhere else.

enfant.cycleAide: The school site follows from the cycle. Change the cycle at the start of the school year and the whole plan updates itself.
enfant.aucunArret: From your address, no stop serves this child's school. Please check the official plan.
enfant.aPied: No bus: the school is right next door
enfant.aPiedDetail: Your address is about {minutes} min on foot from {site}. No bus journey is planned for {prenom}: the nearest stop is the school’s own.

repas.aide: Set day by day: a child can eat at the Dillendapp on Monday and come home on Tuesday.
repas.sansPeriscolaire: This child comes home for lunch every day. Tick “Has lunch at the Dillendapp” if they sometimes eat there.

dillendapp.recuperation: To collect from the Dillendapp at {heure}.
dillendapp.aDeposer: To drop off at the Dillendapp
dillendapp.depose: To drop off at the Dillendapp at {heure}.
dillendapp.inscriptionMidiAide: Tick this if the child eats lunch there, even just one day a week.
dillendapp.inscriptionHorsMidi: At the Dillendapp before class or after school
dillendapp.inscriptionHorsMidiAide: Tick this if you drop them off in the morning, or pick them up at the end of the day. This is set independently of lunch.
dillendapp.blocMatinAide: You drop the child off at the after-school centre yourself: no bus leaves from your home on those mornings. The bus then takes them to class.
dillendapp.blocSoirAide: The child stays at the after-school centre after class: the bus drops them there instead of bringing them home, and you collect them there.
dillendapp.deposeCase: I drop them off that day
dillendapp.bornes: Between {min} and {max}, depending on their cycle’s bus
dillendapp.midiObligatoire: There are no afternoon classes that day: staying at the Dillendapp means having lunch there. Lunch has been set accordingly.

bus.aide: If you drop off or pick up your child yourself on some days, say so here: the app will then only show the journeys they actually take.

manquants.retour-soir: There is no return bus that day: there are no afternoon classes and the late-day runs do not operate. Plan to collect your child from the Dillendapp.
manquants.generique: The official plan provides no bus for this journey.

aujourdhui.raisonInconnue: This year's school calendar is not yet recorded in the app. Please check the official calendar.

arrets.precisionApproximativeAide: The exact location of this stop could not be verified. The walking time is therefore even more indicative than usual.

notes.huttange-c3-uniquement: This departure is reserved for children from Huttange attending the school in Elvange (cycle 3). Children from Huttange attending Noerdange (cycle 2) take the Aller 3.
notes.voir-aller-3: Huttange is not served by this line: see the "Aller Bus 3" timetable.
notes.huttange-retour-dillendapp-1345: Children from Huttange may take the "Retour Bus Dillendapp" at 13:45 in Huttange.
notes.depart-non-precise: The official plan does not state the exact stop for this departure in Beckerich.
notes.vendredi-hall-sportif: On Fridays, departure is from the sports hall rather than the school.
notes.horaire-intermediaire-non-publie: The official plan does not publish a time for this stop.

incertitudes.titre: Not settled by the official plan

calendrier.icsAide: Works with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook. School holidays are already excluded.
calendrier.tousLesEnfantsAide: A single file for all the siblings: one calendar instead of three.
calendrier.commentImporter: How do I add it to my calendar?

agenda.titre: Add the timetable to your calendar
agenda.intro: The downloaded file is imported once. The journeys then appear every week in your phone's calendar.
agenda.atoutVacances: School holidays and public holidays are already excluded: no bus announced in February.
agenda.atoutRappel: A reminder goes off a few minutes before you need to leave the house.
agenda.atoutSupprimer: Everything sits in a separate calendar you can hide or delete in one move.
agenda.remarqueMiseAJour: The calendar does not update itself: after a change of cycle or timetable, download the file again and re-import it.
iosEtapes: Tap the downloaded file, at the bottom of the screen or in the Files app.
Choose “Add All” when iOS offers it.
androidEtapes: Open the file from the notification bar or the Files app.
Choose Google Calendar from the list of apps.
googleEtapes: Choose the file, then the destination calendar, and click “Import”.
agenda.googleAide: No file to import: the app creates one calendar per child and writes the journeys into it.
agenda.googlePortee: The permission requested only grants access to calendars created by this app. Your personal calendar stays out of reach, even for reading.
agenda.googleErreur: Synchronisation failed. Reconnect your account and try again.

partage.aide: Send this link to the other parent, the grandparents or the childminder: they will see exactly the same screen.
partage.confidentialite: The data travels inside the link itself and passes through no server.
partage.recuAide: Do you want to replace your current setup with this one?

impression.aide: One A4 page per child, for the fridge door.
impression.familleAide: A single A4 page: the five days as rows, one child per column.

carte.horsLigne: The map needs a connection. The rest of the app works offline.

reglages.effacerConfirmation: Erase the address, children and preferences saved on this device?

plan.intro: The times below are a transcription of the municipality's official plan. In case of any discrepancy, the original document prevails.
plan.horairesEcoleDetail: Classes from {matinDebut} to {matinFin} Monday to Friday, and from {apresMidiDebut} to {apresMidiFin} on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays.
plan.avertissementHorairesDetail: Times are indicative and may vary slightly depending on traffic conditions. We recommend being at the stop 5 minutes before the scheduled time. Should times change exceptionally (bad weather, roadworks, etc.), parents are informed by email or through the school.

validite.confirmeOral: As this confirmation was verbal, it should be checked again at the start of each school year.
validite.perime: Warning: this plan has passed its stated validity period ({fin}). Check the official plan before relying on it.

limites.titre: What this site can do, and what it cannot
limites.intro: This site is a convenience. It does not replace the official plan and guarantees nothing. Here are its limits, precisely.
limites.marcheCorps: The distance is measured as the crow flies, then increased by a third to account for the layout of the streets, at 4.5 km/h. The site knows nothing of pavements, gradients or road crossings. Allow yourself a margin.
limites.arretsCorps: Not every stop in the municipal plan appears in public databases. Those whose position could not be verified are flagged as such in the app.
limites.tempsReelCorps: The site shows scheduled times. It knows nothing about delays, diversions, breakdowns, strikes or the weather.
limites.planTitre: The plan can change without the site knowing
limites.planCorps: The municipality may change the times at any moment. The site is updated by hand, with best effort, but a lag is possible.
limites.incertitudesTitre: Some rules in the plan remain ambiguous
limites.incertitudesCorps: Where the official document does not decide, the site shows its assumption and says so, rather than presenting an answer as certain.
limites.dillendappTitre: In the morning, the after-school centre is not served the same way everywhere
limites.dillendappCorps: If you drop your child off at the Dillendapp yourself before class, the site no longer suggests a bus from your home — but it does look for the Dillendapp → school leg, which the plan publishes. Depending on the cycle, that leg arrives before or after the start of class: a child in Oberpallen arrives at 07:45, a child in Noerdange at 08:00, that is after the 07:55 bell. The site shows the time published by the municipality; it does not correct it and does not invent any service.
limites.adressesTitre: Per-day addresses only work inside the municipality
limites.adressesCorps: For a given day you can set a departure or arrival address other than your home. The address search, however, only knows the municipality of Beckerich: for a place outside it, name the stop used directly rather than letting the site guess.
limites.donneesCorps: The address and first names are stored on your device only. There is no account, no server and no analytics. Goat Counter analytics are enabled via the installed script. A share link carries the data in its fragment, which the server never receives. If you turn on notifications, an anonymous device identifier is stored on a server for as long as the subscription lasts, and deleted as soon as you turn them off.
limites.notificationsCorps: They warn of a cancellation or a delay, but nothing guarantees they arrive: phone off, Do Not Disturb, push service outage. Nor can a web app mark itself as priority. The school and the municipality remain the official channel; this app does not replace them.

independance.corps1: This site has no connection with the municipality of Beckerich, with the fundamental school or with the Dillendapp maison relais. It was neither commissioned, approved nor reviewed by them.
independance.corps2: It was made by a parent, privately and free of charge, to avoid having to reread the PDF every morning.
independance.corps3: The bus plan remains the property of the municipality. It may be changed at any time, without notice and without this site being informed.
independance.corps4: Best efforts will be made to update the site promptly after any known change, but no guarantee of result is given.
independance.corps5: In case of doubt or discrepancy, the municipality's official document prevails.

installer.intro: Installed on your home screen, the app opens full screen, starts instantly and works without a connection.
iosEtapes: Tap the Share button (the square with an upward arrow) at the bottom of the screen.
Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
installer.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad, only Safari can install a web app. Chrome and Firefox for iOS do not offer it.
androidEtapes: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right.
Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
bureauEtapes: Open this site in Chrome or Edge.
Click the install icon in the address bar, on the right.
installer.firefoxNote: Firefox on desktop cannot install web apps. Bookmark the site instead. On Android, Firefox offers "Add to Home screen" in its menu.
installer.dejaInstallee: The app is already installed on this device.
installer.inviteCorps: The app then opens like any other, straight from your home screen.
installer.atoutHorsLigne: Timetables stay available with no network, at the bus stop as on the train.
installer.atoutNotifications: Disruption notifications become possible — essential on iPhone, where they do not exist otherwise.
installer.atoutPleinEcran: No more address bar: the whole screen shows timetables.
installer.atoutPoids: Installing downloads nothing extra: the site already in memory simply gets an icon.
installer.conditionNotificationsIOS: On iPhone and iPad, Safari only allows notifications from the home screen. Without installing the app you will never be told about a cancelled bus.
installer.conditionNotificationsAutre: Once installed, the app can warn you of a cancellation or a delay, even when closed. It is the only way to be told without opening the site.

urgences.avertissementFiabilite: This information is published by hand and with best effort. It guarantees nothing: if in doubt, contact the school or the municipality.

notifications.aide: Get a notification on this phone when a bus is cancelled or changed. You can unsubscribe at any time.
notifications.activees: Notifications are on for this device.
notifications.refusees: Notifications were blocked in your browser settings. You need to allow them again from the site settings.
notifications.nonSupportees: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.nonConfigurees: Notifications are not set up on this site yet.
notifications.iosNote: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work once the app has been added to the Home Screen.
notifications.confidentialite: Turning notifications on stores an anonymous device identifier on a server for as long as the subscription lasts. It is the only data that leaves your phone, and it is deleted as soon as you unsubscribe.
notifications.erreur: Subscription failed. Please try again later.

preferenceAide.urgences: One notification per cancellation or serious disruption, with no repeat.
preferenceAide.urgences-rappels: As above, plus a reminder in the morning if the disruption lasts. This is the recommended setting.
preferenceAide.tout: Including plain information. The banner in the app already shows those when you open it.

notifications.prioriteAide: A web notification arrives like any other: it is your phone that decides whether it stands out. A few settings make a large difference.
iosEtapes: The app must be installed on the home screen: without that, iOS delivers no web notifications at all.
Remove the app from the “Scheduled Summary”: it bundles notifications at fixed times, and would deliver the cancellation after the bus.
In any Focus mode, add the app to the exceptions.
androidEtapes: Allow the site's notifications when the browser asks.
Settings → Apps → your browser → Notifications: check the site is allowed.
Remove the browser from battery optimisation, or messages may wait for hours.
Under “Do not disturb”, add the browser to the exceptions.
ordinateurEtapes: Allow the site's notifications when the browser asks.
Leave the browser open: closed, it receives nothing.
Check the system is not in focus or presentation mode.
notifications.pasUneGarantieDetail: A web app cannot mark itself as priority: the iOS “time sensitive” level is reserved for native apps. And a notification may never arrive — phone off, Do Not Disturb, push service outage.
notifications.ecoleReste: The school and the municipality remain the official channel. This app does not replace them, and relieves nobody of informing parents.
notifications.essaiCorps: If you are reading this, your notifications work.
notifications.essaiEnvoye: Sent. It should arrive within a few seconds — if it does not, go through the steps above again.
notifications.essaiTropFrequent: One test a minute is enough. Try again shortly.
notifications.essaiEchec: The test did not go out. Turn notifications off and on again, then retry.

admin.intro: Publish a one-off disruption: cancellation, delay, moved stop or plain information. The reference plan is left untouched.
admin.pasUnVerrou: This page is not a lock
admin.pasUnVerrouDetail: Anyone can open it — it is a public page. What protects publishing is write access to the GitHub repository, which only an authorised account has.
admin.jetonAide: Fallback if GitHub sign-in is unavailable. Use a token restricted to this single repository, with write access to contents. It is only kept for the lifetime of the tab.
admin.editerSurGithub: Edit the file directly on GitHub
admin.accesRefuseDetail: The account {login} does not have write access to this repository. Ask the site owner for access.
admin.responsabiliteDetail: What you publish here appears to every parent and may trigger a notification. A false announcement would leave children waiting outside. Check the line, the date and the wording before publishing.
admin.publiee: Disruption published. Parents will see it within one to two minutes.
admin.expiration: The disruption clears itself the day after the end date.
admin.messagePlaceholder: Road closed in Hovelange, the bus will not run.
admin.messageAide: One short, concrete sentence. This is what the parent reads on their phone.
admin.messageLangue: The message is published as written, in your language. Parents will see it in that language.
admin.apercuAide: This is exactly what the affected parents will see.
admin.delai: Publishing creates a commit on the repository. The site updates within one to two minutes.
admin.aucune: No disruption published at the moment.

erreur.jeton-invalide: Token rejected by GitHub. Check that it is valid and has not expired.
erreur.conflit: Someone changed the file in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
erreur.lecture-impossible: Could not read the disruptions file on GitHub.

commune.intro: For municipal staff only. Enter the personal code you were given.
commune.nonConfiguree: The municipality area is not enabled on this installation.
commune.codeAide: Format xxxx-xxxx. Capitals and spaces do not matter.
commune.oubliAide: Lost or forgotten your code? Ask the person who maintains the site for a new one. The old one will be revoked.
commune.allerAlertesAide: A cancelled bus, a delay, a moved stop, a message to pass on.
commune.allerHorairesAide: Permanently correct a departure time in the official plan.
commune.responsabiliteDetail: What you publish here appears immediately for every family and may trigger a notification. A false announcement leaves children outside.
commune.porteeLarge: With no line and no stop, this announcement will appear for every family in the municipality.
commune.expiration: The announcement disappears on its own the day after the end date.
commune.messagePlaceholder: The 07:25 bus is not running this morning.
commune.publiee: Published. Parents will see it next time they open the app.
commune.apercuAide: This is exactly what parents will see.
commune.delai: Going live takes one to two minutes.
commune.retirerConfirmation: Remove this disruption? It will disappear from the app.
commune.horairesAvertissement: Permanent change to the official plan
commune.horairesAvertissementDetail: These times become the reference for every family. For a one- or two-day change, prefer a disruption: it is reversible and immediate.
commune.aucuneModification: No change yet. Edit a time above.
commune.heureInvalide: One of the times entered is not valid. Correct it before publishing.
commune.planPublie: Published. The site will be rebuilt within one to two minutes.
commune.reconstruction: Publishing rebuilds the site: allow one to two minutes before parents see the change.
commune.publierPlanConfirmation: Publish {nombre} time change(s)? They become the reference for every family.

situation.annulationAide: The service is not running. Affected trips will be struck through.
situation.retardAide: The service runs, but later. Times will be recalculated.
situation.deplacementAide: Roadworks, closed road: children board elsewhere.
situation.informationAide: Neither a cancellation nor a delay: just a message to families.

gravites.infoAide: Good to know, with no effect on journeys.
gravites.attentionAide: Parents should read it before taking their child to the stop.
gravites.alerteAide: Triggers a notification for subscribed families.

erreur.codeInconnu: This code is not recognised. Check it, or ask for a new one.
erreur.tropDeTentatives: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
erreur.sessionExpiree: Your session has expired. Sign in again with your code.
erreur.conflit: Someone published in the meantime. Reload the page and start again.
erreur.reseau: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
erreur.inconnu: Publishing failed. Try again in a moment.
erreur.nonActivee: This space is not yet enabled on the server. Tell whoever maintains the app: a configuration key is missing.

commune.rappelsAide: A reminder is only sent at the useful times of the day concerned — before 07:40 in the morning, before 15:00 in the afternoon — and never on a day without school.
commune.journalAide: Who published what, and when. Kept for 90 days, then deleted automatically.
commune.journalEchec: The log could not be read. Close and reopen it.

adminArrets.aide: Check each stop on the map. Green dots are confirmed, orange ones remain approximate.
adminArrets.mode: Click a dot to pick the stop, then click the map at the exact spot.
adminArrets.jusquaAide: An end date only applies to a temporary correction; left empty, it stands until removed.
adminArrets.differenceAide: Temporary: takes effect within a minute, no rebuild, and is reversible. Permanent: changes the reference data, takes effect after a rebuild.
adminArrets.cliquerCarte: Click the map to set the exact position.

adminPlan.aide: Replace the reference plan with a new JSON file. The filename stays the same, only its content changes.
adminPlan.prudence: The riskiest operation on the site
adminPlan.prudenceDetail: An incorrect plan would skew the timetables of every family at once. Nothing is published while an error remains, and the tests check again before going live.
adminPlan.actuel: Current plan: {annee} — {lignes} lines, {courses} runs, {arrets} stops served.
adminPlan.publie: Plan published. The tests are running, then the site will update.
adminPlan.jsonInvalide: The content is not valid JSON:
adminPlan.aucunProbleme: No problem found. The plan can be published.
adminPlan.avertissements: {nombre} warning(s) — worth checking, but not blocking
adminPlan.moinsQuAvant: The new plan has fewer runs than the current one. Check that it is not incomplete.
adminPlan.filet: After publishing, the tests run before deployment. If they fail, the site stays on the previous version.

traductions.aide: Each correction overlays the compiled text without replacing it: it applies from the next opening, with no site rebuild. The French text stays visible for reference.
traductions.langueAide: French is the reference: correcting it also changes the fallback for the other languages.
traductions.recherche: Search a key or a text
traductions.publiee: Corrections published. They will show the next time the app is opened.

refus.langue-inconnue: That language does not exist in the app.
refus.cle-inconnue: That text does not exist in French: only what is already there can be corrected.
refus.type-different: The original does not have that shape: a list does not replace a sentence, nor the other way round.
refus.longueur-liste: Exactly as many steps as the original are needed.
refus.trop-long: Text too long: 400 characters at most.
refus.vide: An empty text would wipe the sentence off the screen. Use “Back to the original wording”.
refus.marqueurs: The placeholders in braces, such as {heure}, must match the French text exactly. They are replaced by a real value when displayed.

traductions.connexionAide: Enter the code you were given to correct the app's wording. It grants access to translations only.

credits.intro: This app was built by a parent in their spare time, and translated with the help of people who gain nothing from it. Here they are.
credits.developpementAide: Design, code and data of the app.
credits.traductionsAide: Reviewing and correcting the wording, language by language.
credits.remerciementsAide: Everyone whose feedback moved the app forward.
credits.accord: Only names whose consent was asked for appear here. To be removed from this page, just write.
credits.lienIgnore: This link will not be clickable: only addresses starting with http:// or https:// are rendered.
credits.sansNom: {nombre} entry/entries without a name: they will not be published.
credits.publiee: Credits published. They will appear after the rebuild, in a minute or two.
credits.editeurAide: These credits are part of the site: publishing them triggers a rebuild, unlike wording corrections.
